thread:
Noah: Heads-up: Nimbus Reseller reports they were invoiced without the partner discount on invoice INV-2026-11-30-NR. They expected the 20% reseller rate applied to recurring charges after signing MOU. Can finance ops review?

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-11-30-NR posted 2026-11-30 17:05Z. Total: $27,600.00. Status: paid. PDF: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-11-30-NR

Zara (Acct Rep): Customer sent MOU showing reseller tier: 20% off recurring line items, effective 2026-10-01. Looks like discount didn't apply to the November invoice.

Noah: pasted invoice lines excerpt:
```
acct,description,period,qty,unit_price,discount,line_total
NR-001,Dedicated instance - monthly,2026-11,1,30000.00,0.00,30000.00
NR-001,Support - premium,2026-11,1,600.00,0.00,600.00
```
System apparently applied no discount. The paid amount in billing-bot reflects taxes & rounding (customer is in EU).

Evan (Sales Ops): Confirmed partner enrollment on 2026-10-01. Discount should be 20% on recurring product SKU only (not on one-time onboarding). This invoice is for monthly dedicated instance which is recurring.

Marta (Tax): Note EU VAT at 20% applied to taxable portion. If we issue a credit for the discount, we must adjust VAT accordingly.

Noah: Quick calc: recurring line 30,000 -> 20% = 6,000 discount. Taxable base reduces by 6,000; VAT @20% = 1,200 reduction. Net customer credit = 7,200. Current posted total 27,600, corrected total should be 20,400.

Zara (Acct Rep): Nimbus requests a refund to card for the overpaid amount rather than account credit. They also want a corrected invoice for their records.

Noah: Proposal: create credit memo CM-2026-1701 for -7,200. Use adj code FIN-RES-2026-412. Reissue invoice INV-2026-11-30-NR-R1 with corrected totals and attach MOU. Need Dir Finance sign-off for refund to CC.

Priya (Dir Finance): Approved. Post the credit memo and process refund to original payment method. GL impact: Revenue Contra 4010 (-6,000), Tax Liability 2410 (-1,200). Book refund processing fees under 5275. Include root cause: partner enrollment flag not propagated.

billing-bot: Credit memo CM-2026-1701 created and linked to INV-2026-11-30-NR. Amount: -7,200.00. Status: pending_refund. Reference FIN-RES-2026-412.

Zara (Acct Rep): I will request payments team to process refund. Nimbus provided payment ID PAY-112233 and card **** 1111. They acknowledged the corrected invoice requirement.

Noah: Also opening a billing bug: BI-2026-502 to ensure partner discount flags are applied at invoice generation and add an automated test for partner rate rules. Assign to eng-billing.

Marta (Tax): After refund posts, we'll rebook VAT reversal entry and confirm VAT report impact for the month. Please attach credit memo to tax pack.

Zara (Acct Rep): Notifying customer that refund is in process and that corrected invoice will follow within 48 hours.

Noah: Thanks team. Closing once refund posts and corrected invoice is sent.
